premises.text: Online merchants must verify shopper identity and keep personal information safe
premises.evidence_span: They need to know that Emily is who she says she is, and once they've confirmed that she is who she says she is, they need to keep her information safe

premises.text: Patented software confirms two parties hold the same information without exchanging that information
premises.evidence_span: patented software that allows two parties to confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information

premises.text: An identity exchange lets organizations publish verified attributes in Siddiqui format for merchants who have never identified the person before
premises.evidence_span: merchants who've never identified somebody before can leverage the information that others have previously done before them

premises.text: Transactional fees per verification with 30% shared back to the information provider
premises.evidence_span: Every verification we do, we charge a fee for. But the interesting thing is we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information

premises.text: Target use cases include real-time fraud monitoring of card transactions and faster identity verification
premises.evidence_span: We're looking to compete in two specific areas, the prevention of fraud, which is real-time monitoring of credit card transactions, and the identity verification area

value.text: Businesses prove identity and keep information safe without moving PII
value.evidence_span: help businesses prove that you are who you say you are and keep your information safe
